title: Source-bound scheduled irrigation root-zone water accounting

equations: multiply lower, middle and actual compartment water contents by dz(node), and multiply again by frlow at noddrz
awlh=sum(wclo-wchi), awmh=sum(wcme-wchi), awah=sum(wcac-wchi), cdef=sum(wclo-wcac), accumulated in increasing node order

scope: pure summation over supplied root-zone nodes and layer-indexed water contents
fractional last root-zone compartment handling at noddrz
non_goals: deriving noddrz, rd, ztopcp, dz, layer, soil water contents or watcon
TCS trigger selection, event creation, water balance or accepted source mass
calendar, solute, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: four accumulated values match direct B1.11 source-order replay bitwise
100000 deterministic columns pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
